title: Allow any daily question count with streak on ≥1 and flat ₹20 fine on 0

requirements.text: Update backend daily reset logic so users can log any number of questions per day (no fixed goal of 5), and apply streak/fine rules as: (a) if questions solved for the day is >= 1, increment current streak by 1 and apply no fine; (b) if questions solved for the day is 0, reset current streak to 0 and apply a flat fine of 20 rupees (always 20, not scaled). Persist the daily record with the day’s questionsSolved and the penaltyApplied amount.

quotes: Remove the rule that forces users to solve exactly 5 questions.
Allow users to solve any number of questions per day.
Streak increases if they solve at least 1 question.
If they solve 0 questions in a day, streak resets and a 20 rs fine is applied. the fine always be 20 rs if they do 0 questions.

acceptanceCriteria: When the daily reset runs, a day with problemsSolved >= 1 produces penaltyApplied = 0 and increases currentStreak by 1.
When the daily reset runs, a day with problemsSolved = 0 produces penaltyApplied = 20 and sets currentStreak to 0.
totalFine and profile.totalFine increase only by the recorded penaltyApplied for that day.
DailyRecord.penaltyApplied is never computed from a missing-goal formula (no (5 - count) * 20 behavior remains).

requirements.text: Update backend APIs that set daily problem count to accept any non-negative count (Nat) without enforcing an upper limit of 5, and ensure the daily count update still triggers a reset first if the user is past the daily reset boundary (so the update applies to the new day).

quotes: Allow users to solve any number of questions per day.

acceptanceCriteria: Calling updateTodayProblems with a count greater than 5 succeeds and updates todayProblemCount accordingly.
Calling updateTodayProblems with 0 succeeds and sets todayProblemCount to 0.
If updateTodayProblems is called after the daily reset time and shouldResetForUser is true, the previous day is processed before storing the new day’s todayProblemCount.

requirements.text: Replace the frontend daily tracking UI that uses 5 checkboxes with an input that lets the user enter the number of questions solved today. If the input is left empty, treat it as 0 questions. Saving the value must call the existing updateTodayProblems mutation with the entered value (or 0 if blank).

quotes: let the user enter the no. of questions they did...if they didn't enter anything..so its 0 questions...

acceptanceCriteria: The DailyTracker component provides a numeric entry for “questions solved today” rather than 5 fixed checkboxes.
If the user clears the input and submits/saves, the app sends 0 to updateTodayProblems.
If the user enters a number (including >5) and submits/saves, the app sends that number to updateTodayProblems and the UI reflects the saved value after mutation success.
All user-facing labels/messages related to this control are in English.

requirements.text: Update the frontend reminder logic and copy to remove the “complete 5 problems” framing. The reminder should be based on maintaining the streak rule: show a reminder when today’s logged questions are 0 (i.e., they have not solved at least 1 question yet).

quotes: Streak increases if they solve at least 1 question.
If they solve 0 questions in a day, streak resets and a 20 rs fine is applied.

acceptanceCriteria: DailyReminder no longer calculates “problems left to complete 5”.
DailyReminder triggers only when stats.todayProblems is 0 (and not dismissed for the day).
Reminder text is updated to English copy consistent with the new rule (at least 1 question keeps streak; 0 breaks streak and applies a 20 rupees fine).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any frontend immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
nonGoals: Do not implement a scaled/multi-day missed fine formula; the fine for a day with 0 questions must remain a flat 20 rupees.
Do not add new authentication methods beyond Internet Identity.
Do not add new databases or external storage services.
